drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.lead: Layouts and form schemas that agents propose. Nothing here is live until a workspace owner or administrator approves it.

review.title: Review draft
review.approveFailed: The draft could not be approved.
review.rejectFailed: The draft could not be rejected.
review.rejectReason: Why is it rejected? The author reads this.
review.cannotApprove: Only a valid, pending draft can be approved.
review.staleBody: The target or the report changed since you opened this draft. The review below shows the current state; check it again before you approve.
review.invalidBody: An invalid draft cannot be approved. The author has to send a corrected one.
review.noPublic: Nothing on a published site shows it.
review.publicWarning: This would be shown to visitors of a published site
review.customCodeBody: It brings custom frames or components. Check who built it before you approve.
review.uploadNote: The signature was verified against a publisher key registered for this workspace. Approving stores the package; it installs nothing.

uploads.title: Package uploads
uploads.lead: Signed packages that agents submit. Approving one stores it as a package; installing it is a separate review.
